successCriteria.description: The Employee entity is defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` with all canonical fields (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt) and imports `EmploymentStatus` from `src/shared/types/index.ts`.

`IEmployeeRepository` interface exposes all eight methods: findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, findByManagerId, findAll, create, update, softDelete — each with the correct return types (nullable for single-lookup, array for multi-result, boolean for softDelete).

`IEmployeeService` interface exposes six methods (getById, getByEmployeeNumber, getSubordinates, create, update, terminate) and the `CreateEmployeeDto` type is defined in the same file with fields: employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId?, department, hireDate.

`EmployeeService.create` constructs an Employee with id generated via `crypto.randomUUID()`, employmentStatus set to `EmploymentStatus.ACTIVE`, createdAt/updatedAt set to `new Date()`, deletedAt set to `null`, and delegates to `repository.create` — returning the created Employee.

`EmployeeService.terminate` sets employmentStatus to `EmploymentStatus.TERMINATED`, terminationDate to `new Date()`, and delegates to `repository.update` — returning the updated Employee or null if not found.
Controller functions return HTTP 200 for successful GET/update/terminate, 201 for successful create, and 404 when the service returns null for a lookup by id/employeeNumber.
`employeeRoutes` registers all employee endpoints on a FastifyInstance under the `/employees` prefix, wiring each route to its corresponding controller function.

Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.service.test.ts` mock `IEmployeeRepository` and verify: create constructs the Employee correctly and calls repo.create; getById delegates and returns the result; getSubordinates delegates to repo.findByManagerId; terminate sets TERMINATED status + terminationDate and calls repo.update.

constraints: Employee module depends only on `src/shared/types/index.ts` (Phase 1) for `EmploymentStatus` and `BaseEntity`. It must not import from any other module (audit, leave-policy, leave-balance, leave-request).
All database access must go through `IEmployeeRepository` — no inline SQL or direct db calls in the service or controller layers (GP-001).
The Employee entity's `employmentStatus` field must use the `EmploymentStatus` enum imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — no string literal or locally redefined enum.
outOfScope: Concrete Knex/Postgres repository implementation — the `IEmployeeRepository` interface is defined in this phase but the implementation is deferred (same pattern as Phase 1's audit module).

ambiguities.description: How do controller functions obtain the `EmployeeService` instance? The PLAN.md does not specify a DI/wiring strategy. Options: (a) module-level singleton instantiated in the routes file, (b) factory function accepting the service, (c) closure-based injection where routes receive the service as a parameter.
options: Module-level singleton instantiated in routes file
Factory function accepting service as parameter

entityInvariants.invariant: Every Employee must have a unique `employeeNumber` and a unique `email` across all non-soft-deleted records. `employmentStatus` must be one of ACTIVE, INACTIVE, or TERMINATED. `hireDate` must be set at creation and must not be in the future. `terminationDate` must be null unless `employmentStatus` is TERMINATED, in which case it must be set. `deletedAt` is null for active records; soft-delete sets it to the current timestamp.

An Employee with `employmentStatus` TERMINATED cannot be the target of new leave-request submissions or balance initializations (enforced by downstream modules, but the status value is the authoritative signal). The `terminate` service method is the sole path to transition an Employee to TERMINATED status.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; RBAC enforcement (e.g. HR admin or manager role required to create employees) is applied at the route level, not inside the service.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Must reject with a typed error if employeeNumber or email already exists. Must validate that all required fields in CreateEmployeeDto are present and non-empty before constructing the entity.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; RBAC enforcement (HR admin or manager role) is applied at the route level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns null if the employee does not exist (caller returns 404). If the employee is already TERMINATED, the operation is idempotent — it sets the same values again and succeeds.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; RBAC enforcement is applied at the route level.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read operations return null (single-lookup) or empty array (multi-result) when no records match — they do not throw.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `Employee` entity must import and use `EmploymentStatus` from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — the exact enum defined in Phase 1 with values ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TERMINATED. No local redefinition.

The `Employee` entity must structurally conform to `BaseEntity` from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — it carries `id: string`, `createdAt: Date`, `updatedAt: Date` with the same semantics (id is a UUID string, timestamps are set at creation and updated on mutation).

The `Employee` entity's `deletedAt: Date | null` field follows the soft-delete pattern: null means active, a Date value means soft-deleted. The `softDelete` repository method sets `deletedAt` to the current timestamp rather than physically removing the row. All repository lookup methods (findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, findByManagerId, findAll) must exclude soft-deleted records (deletedAt IS NOT NULL filter).

The module's public surface (`index.ts` barrel export) must re-export Employee, IEmployeeRepository, IEmployeeService, EmployeeService, and the route registration function — matching the pattern established by the audit module's barrel export at `src/modules/audit/index.ts`.

integrationPoints.why: Imports `EmploymentStatus` enum and conforms to `BaseEntity` shape — the sole external dependency of the Employee module.
